name: Back Office Reports
description: Plain reports for an owner: visits, online bookings, orders and takings with change on the last period, a daily visits chart, traffic sources and most-visited pages.
usage: Give it the /admin/reports route and replace the sample data object with figures from your analytics (Plausible and Cloudflare both have simple APIs) and your bookings and orders tables. Security: put every back-office screen behind sign-in (for example Supabase Auth or Clerk), let only the owner's account read or write this data (in Supabase, with row-level security on every table), and keep admin pages out of the public navigation and sitemap.
